title: Delivery Schedule
clause_text: Supplier shall deliver materials according to the agreed delivery schedule.

title: Delay and Liquidated Damages
clause_text: Where delay is attributable to the supplier, contractual delay remedies may apply after the contractual grace period.

title: Material Quantity
clause_text: Supplier shall provide the quantities stated in the purchase order and approved bill of quantities.

title: Quality Acceptance
clause_text: Materials failing inspection may be rejected and replaced by the supplier.

title: Notice of Delay
clause_text: The supplier shall notify the client promptly of circumstances likely to affect delivery.

title: Change Orders
clause_text: Changes in scope or quantities shall be handled through an approved change order process.
